description: This file provides database utility functions for managing a SQLite database, including path resolution, schema initialization, and connection handling within a note management system.

methods.name: str _default_db_path()
methods.description: Determines and returns the default path to the SQLite database, which is located in a sibling directory 'notes_database' relative to the project root.

methods.name: str get_db_path()
methods.description: Retrieves the database path from environment variable 'NOTES_DB_PATH' or defaults to the path provided by '_default_db_path'.

methods.name: None initialize_db_schema(conn: sqlite3.Connection)
methods.description: Creates the 'notes' table in the SQLite database if it does not already exist.

methods.name: Iterator[sqlite3.Connection] get_connection(readonly: Optional[bool] = False)
methods.description: Provides a context manager to establish a SQLite connection, with optional read-only mode, schema initialization, and proper connection settings including foreign key support.
